correctness.rationale: An exhaustive ten-vertex reconstruction identifies exactly ten facets (all K2,3 cross-edge sets), 371 faces, and a verified complete Forman acyclic matching with 179 pairs, one critical vertex and eleven critical 3-simplices. Its entire 370-vertex, 1320-arrow directed Hasse graph is a DAG, so the Morse CW complex is a wedge of eleven 3-spheres integrally. Independently computed GF2 boundary ranks agree. For each of the 120 label permutations, oriented simplicial chain traces and Lefschetz give the exact character; independently expanded Frobenius alternants yield precisely the Specht constituents (3,2), (2,2,1), (1^5). No infinite-family assertion rests on finite data.

value.rationale: For the canonical nonchordal, highly symmetric triangular graph (line graph of K5), the previously unreported ordinary four-cut complex has an exact nontrivial sphere-wedge homotopy type eleven ranks strong, uniform non-shellability in pure dimension 5, and a complete three-summand S5 representation with no invariant vectors and one sign copy. This motivated cut-parameter transition is structurally different from both the 3-cut dual and the larger all-bipartite-graphs complex. The precise character and homotopy type offer meaningful reusable data for equivariant cut-complex theory; the result is not a bare known-table recalculation.
